summary: Frontend-only testing of JMLPH landing page redesign. All 9 sections render, no console/page errors. Header transitions to glassmorphism on scroll. Hero CTAs fully opaque. In-page anchor navigation (#current-issue, #most-read) works via Lenis. External nav links (About, Archive, For Authors) point to correct jmlph.net URLs. All 4 'Make a Submission' entry points link to correct submissions URL. Current Issue shows 4 Original Articles + 1 Commentary + 1 Law and Ethics = 6 article rows, each with title link and PDF link to correct jmlph.net URLs (target=_blank). Most Read shows 5 numbered items with correct view counts (602/583/448/322/310). At-a-Glance shows all 7 stats. Information section has all Atom/RSS2/RSS1 feed links + For Readers/Authors/Librarians links pointing to correct URLs. Footer has mailto contact, both ISSNs, ARETION and OJS links. Logo and hero image load (naturalWidth 2000/1170). Mobile 390px: hamburger toggle visible, mobile-menu opens with all nav links + submission button, no horizontal overflow (sw=cw=390). Desktop no horizontal overflow. No elements stuck at low opacity after entrance animations.

issues: 46% acceptance-rate stat badge overlaps the '3 · 2026' / 'ISSN 2788-791X' meta text at the bottom of the hero image — minor visual overlap on desktop 1920 viewport

action_items: Optional: reposition the 46% badge or the hero meta strip so the badge no longer overlaps the '3 · 2026 / ISSN 2788-791X' text on desktop
critical_code_review_comments: App.js wraps everything in ReactLenis with anchors:true — anchor smooth-scroll works, verified.

All interactive elements expose data-testid consistently (hero-read-btn, hero-submit-btn, article-row, article-pdf-link, article-title-link, most-read-item, feed-*, info-*, footer-*, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-menu).
External links correctly set target=_blank; consider also adding rel="noopener noreferrer" if not already (not audited on every link).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static frontend only, no backend. Uses Lenis smooth scroll — use real mouse.wheel or click in-page anchor <a href='#...'> to scroll; native window.scrollTo may be overridden. All key elements carry data-testid. Preview URL from frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
